title: After The Blackout, Ben Was NICE 🔦
description:
In this town, a blackout can swap anyone sitting alone in the dark with another version of themselves. So families sit together with flashlights, and when the lights come back, everybody checks.

My big brother Ben and I haven't been nice to each other in three years. After Tuesday's blackout, he made me a sandwich and cut off the crusts.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment STAY if you'd keep the nice brother.
